title: The Unheeded Call in the Land of Arrogance
intro: You stand in the ruins of a once-great civilization, where power and pride knew no bounds. A messenger walked among them, calling to the truth, but their hearts were hardened. The warning went unheeded, and the sky itself became an instrument of wrath. Who was this messenger, and what became of those who rejected the call?
clues: I was sent to a people who were unmatched in strength and who built on every high place a monument.
My people considered themselves invincible and said, 'Who is mightier than us in strength?'
I called them to worship Allah alone, but they accused me of foolishness and lying.
They challenged me to bring the punishment I promised if I was truthful.
Allah sent upon them a barren wind that spared nothing it came upon.
I and those who believed with me were saved by Allah's mercy, while the disbelievers were utterly destroyed.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: A devastating wind destroyed the disbelievers
A great flood engulfed the disbelievers
A shower of stones rained down
A loud shriek seized the disbelievers
trial.answer: A devastating wind destroyed the disbelievers

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Hud and the believers were saved, and the disbelievers were destroyed
Hud was raised to a high station
Hud was killed by his people
Hud's people repented and were spared
Hud left his people before any punishment
outcome.answer: Hud and the believers were saved, and the disbelievers were destroyed

arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَقَطَعْنَا دَابِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا ۖ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verse: So We saved him and those with him by mercy from Us. And We eliminated those who denied Our signs, and they were not [at all] believers. (7:72)
